subject: Expectation gate + bar-raiser request for Sr. Inference candidate (Alex Jenkins)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expectation gate + bar-raiser request for Sr. Inference candidate (Alex Jenkins)

Hi team —

We have Alex Jenkins (Brightwave AI) coming through for final on-site loop next week. Quick ask: I want to run a tight expectation gate and lock a bar-raiser for the debrief. Alex is a strong infra/serving candidate but comes from a non-traditional background (product-heavy at Brightwave).

Requesting:
- One bar-raiser volunteer to own the final pass on leveling and signal prioritization (I propose Markus, if available).
- Agreement on two interview focus areas: 1) end-to-end inference architecture (latency trade-offs, KV cache strategies), 2) degradation & rollback strategy (reliability + fallback).
- 30-min calibration sync before debrief to align anchors and pass/fail gates.

Attached the role spec and the candidate pack for context. Please reply with: (A) whether you can be the bar-raiser; (B) any redlines to the scope below; (C) available 30-min slots on Apr 6-7.

Role scope (short): Senior Inference Engineer — responsible for production runtime decisions, cost-latency tradeoffs, and onboarding new open models into the serving runtime. Target leveling: Senior (L5) or Staff (L6) depending on signal.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Serving Platforms, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expectation gate + bar-raiser request for Sr. Inference candidate (Alex Jenkins)

Irene —

Happy to serve as bar-raiser for this loop. I want to keep the calibration short and signal-focused. Suggested framing for the 30-min sync:
- 5m: level & pass/fail criteria (what separates L5 from L6 here)
- 10m: key evidence buckets (design depth, trade-off articulation, execution experience)
- 10m: question/anchor distribution across interviewers
- 5m: logistics (who fills rubric, next steps)

Availability windows (PT): Apr 6 9:30–10:30, Apr 6 15:00–16:00, Apr 7 10:00–11:00.

Also: from the role spec, we should call out "quantization/latency budgets" and "fallthrough behavior to cheaper variants" as specific prompts for on-site questions.

-Markus
Principal, Inference Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expectation gate + bar-raiser request for Sr. Inference candidate (Alex Jenkins)

Thanks — looping in a couple of quick ops items from recruiting side:
- Candidate logistics: Alex confirmed interview day availability on Apr 7 (full day). He'll be remote.
- Recruiting prefers we keep final leveling decision documented in the debrief doc; I've attached our debrief template for consistency.

Question for the hiring team: do we want to gate on shipped impact (examples of production features) OR depth of technical contribution? My suggestion is to use both but weight production runtime ownership slightly higher for L6.

I'll also send the candidate's resume and short tech write-up to the panel separately (attaching candidate pack now).

Marissa
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
Attachment: debrief-template.docx, candidate-alex-jenkins-pack.zip

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expectation gate + bar-raiser request for Sr. Inference candidate (Alex Jenkins)

On Mon, Apr 4, 2027 at 11:03 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene —
> 
> Happy to serve as bar-raiser for this loop. I want to keep the calibration short and signal-focused. Suggested framing for the 30-min sync:
> - 5m: level & pass/fail criteria (what separates L5 from L6 here)
> - 10m: key evidence buckets (design depth, trade-off articulation, execution experience)
> - 10m: question/anchor distribution across interviewers
> - 5m: logistics (who fills rubric, next steps)

Thanks Markus — I agree with your framing.

Irene: I can take the 15:00 PT slot on Apr 6. Markus, if you can do 15:00 as well we should lock it. Jonas, Marissa — please confirm.

Extra note on scope: please add an explicit prompt for "approach to progressive rollouts and rollback criteria" — this is been a recurring signal miss for candidates who can design systems but not operate them at scale.

Grace
Director, Applied ML

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T16:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expectation gate + bar-raiser request for Sr. Inference candidate (Alex Jenkins)

Locked: 30-min calibration sync Apr 6, 15:00–15:30 PT. Markus is the bar-raiser — thank you. Agenda + pre-read below.

Meeting agenda (calibration sync):
- 5m overview of candidate context (resume highlights, role fit)
- 10m pass/fail anchors: L5 vs L6 (production ownership, ambiguity handling, design breadth)
- 10m evidence buckets & rubric owner assignments
- 5m confirm debrief timeline and who circulates notes

Pre-read (please review before the sync):
- Role_Spec_Sr-Inference.pdf (attached)
- resume-alex-jenkins.pdf (attached)
- debrief-template.docx (attached)

Immediate asks before we meet:
1) Markus — bring 2–3 concrete examples of what you would expect to see for an L6 signal in the "execution" bucket.
2) Marissa — please confirm who will fill the shared rubric during debrief (recruiting or hiring manager).
3) Jonas/Grace — flag any non-starter concerns you want called out to the panel in advance.

Post-debrief: please populate the debrief-template within 24 hours. If there's a split vote on level, Markus will make the final call as bar-raiser per our hire policy.

Thanks all — looking forward. I'll follow up with a calendar invite and the Google Meet link.

Irene
Head of Serving Platforms, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Role_Spec_Sr-Inference.pdf, resume-alex-jenkins.pdf, debrief-template.docx
